title: docs(adr): ADR-0048 §3.5 rename-on-install ships for unmanaged copies; ADR-0131 D6 notes the Q3 extension and the Q6 answer
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiU1rhbHT2BKdngdowSzudqP)_
Fixes #30794
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两份 ADR 加注记。ADR-0048 §3.5「装时改名」从「暂不做」改为「unmanaged 副本可以改名，managed 永不改名」；ADR-0131 D6 记下副本可带自己的 namespace，以及 Q6 的裁定。
- 为什么改：PR A（#30997）和 PR C（#31182）已经上线了改名安装，ADR 还写着「不做」；Q6 你已裁定 B（改名副本不拒绝），要落进决策记录。
- 风险与回滚：只改文档，不动代码、不发版；原段落一字未改，只在旁边加带日期的注记和状态行条目；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md`（D6 Unmanaged 后的新注记，Q6 那段）、`docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md`（§3.5 下的注记）。
- 两分钟验证：打开 ADR-0131 搜「Note (2026-11-07, #30794)」，读 Q6 一段，预期写的是「改名副本不拒绝，未改名副本 Q6 原文有效」，并引用裁定记录 6709037798。
- 需要你做的：Fable 复核与席位 ACCEPT 之后，由维护者（os-zhuang 或 hotlong）合并。

## What changes

Docs only, two files, nothing else (`skip-changeset`: the diff publishes nothing).

- **ADR-0048 §3.5.** The original paragraph stays verbatim. A dated note `Amended (2026-11-07, #30794)` records that rename-on-install ships for unmanaged copies only: a `targetNamespace` on an unmanaged install renames the copy through `planNamespaceRename` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/package-namespace-rename.ts`), the one engine `duplicatePackage` already applies (ADR-0070 D4). It states what the two doors share and what they do not (only the duplicate rebinds a permission set's `packageId`, ADR-0086 D3; only the import judges copy names against the item-name grammar and the 63/255 limits); that a view container follows its object on both doors; the refusals before the base exists, including the `targetNamespace` refusals that answer `400 INVALID_REQUEST` since #31182; that §3.2 runs on the renamed names; that a managed install is never renamed (`targetNamespace` beside it: `400 INVALID_REQUEST`); provenance (`sourceNamespace`, `installedFrom.namespace`); and that the CLI sends no `targetNamespace`. Out of scope: bare non-object names (ruling C on #30798), seed data, and the hosted-cloud default namespace (objectstack-ai/cloud#3624). The status line gains an **Amended** entry.
- **ADR-0131 D6.** After the **Unmanaged** bullet, a dated note `Note (2026-11-07, #30794)`: Q3 on #15213 (seat answer, stage-0 ACCEPT record `6108175106`) is extended — the copy still goes into a NEW base, and keeps the source namespace unless the install names a `targetNamespace`. Q6 (same record) does not apply to a renamed copy, by the maintainer's ruling **B** (record `6709037798` on #30794, 「B 不拒绝（推荐）」); for a copy that kept the source namespace, Q6 stands exactly as written. The status line gains an **Amended** entry.

## Review

- **Fable review (independent, contract tier), verdict PASS with nits**, no must-fix or should-fix. Scope per the narrowed rule: the two ADR diffs, checked claim by claim against the code they describe. Files it read: both ADRs; `packages/metadata-protocol/src/package-unmanaged-install.ts` (whole), `package-namespace-rename.ts` (whole), `protocol-package-commits.ts` (duplicate and import callers); `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` (managed `targetNamespace` refusal, step 1f `findEnvironmentBaseHoldingNamespace`, `installedFrom`); `marketplace-install-local-install-modes.test.ts` (the Q6 = B pair); `content/docs/deployment/install-modes.mdx`; `packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts`; `packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`; ADR-0070 and ADR-0086 headings. It also confirmed records `6108175106` and `6709037798`.
- Nits applied in `35c09fa7`: "Every reference to a renamed name follows" narrowed to "Every reference the engine reads follows (the first bullet below says where)"; the #15213 Q3/Q6 now say they are that record's, not ADR-0131's own §6 Q3/Q6. Not changed: the status-entry punctuation (harmless), and the cloud#3624 citation (not verifiable from this repo, kept as the card states it). Under the narrowed rule no delta re-review is owed for nits.

## Acceptance notes

- objectstack-ai/cloud#3600 comment 6676044775 (the epic ruling) was not read: it is in another repository this session cannot reach. Someone who can read it should check the §3.5 note agrees with it.
- ADR-0048's TL;DR item 5, its non-goals line and Phase 4 still describe rename-on-install as a non-goal; they are kept verbatim as the record's original text, and the status line plus the §3.5 note carry the amendment.
